summary: Plan corporate messages, coordinate channels and evaluate results using AMEC, RACE and PESO. Explore the course and build practical communication outputs.
lede: Corporate communication coordinates messages for employees and other stakeholders across channels. For communications officers, internal communication leads and corporate affairs managers, the course builds practical skills to audit communication activity, map stakeholders, develop consistent messages and select channels. You’ll use the AMEC Integrated Evaluation Framework, RACE and PESO to define measures, assess evidence and report findings for decision-making.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for coordinating corporate messages, internal communication, corporate affairs or communication performance. It suits working professionals who need practical planning and evaluation methods for real communication tasks.
prerequisites: Prior experience preparing, reviewing or coordinating workplace communications is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
